<thought>Search the template catalog for retrosynthetic templates that form a C‑C double bond and a carboxylic ester in the forward direction, using a representative product (ethyl crotonate) as the target molecule. This should retrieve templates related to the Still‑Gennari/HWE reaction.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CCOC(=O)C=CC",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds", "carboxylic esters"],
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
